syllabus_topics: Introduction; organization; safety regulations; assignment of the term paper

Supervised practical work on both conventional and NC machines based on the design brief (determination of the technological procedure and cutting conditions, machine and tool adjustment, production and final inspection). Examples of statistical and operational diagnostics and measurement will be demonstrated (stiffness, accuracy, noise, temperature 
 thermal camera, vibrations etc.).
A seminar at a CNC production machine seller. A demonstration of machine technological capabilities.
A seminar at a machine tool producer. A discussion with representatives of the design, technology and personnel department.
Term paper assessment and course credit
